articles.title_en: Persecution and Escape: Professional Networks and High-Skilled Emigration from Nazi Germany
articles.title_cn: 迫害与逃离：专业网络与纳粹德国高技能人才移民
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of professional networks in facilitating emigration of Jewish academics dismissed from their positions by the Nazi government. We use individual-level exogenous variation in the timing of dismissals to estimate causal effects. Academics with more ties to early émigrés (emigrated 1933–1934) were more likely to emigrate. Early émigrés functioned as “bridging nodes” that facilitated emigration to their own destination. We also provide evidence of decay in social ties over time and show that professional networks transmit information that is not publicly observable. Finally, we study the relative importance of three types (family, community, professional) of social networks. (JEL I31, J44, N34, N44, Z12, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了专业网络在促进被纳粹政府解雇的犹太学者移民中所起的作用。我们利用解雇时间上的个体层面外生变异来估计因果效应。与早期移民（1933-1934年移民）有更多联系的学者更有可能移民。早期移民充当了“桥梁节点”，促进了向自己目的地的移民。我们还提供了社会联系随时间衰减的证据，并表明专业网络传递了公开不可观察的信息。最后，我们研究了三种类型（家庭、社区、专业）社会网络的相对重要性。（JEL I31, J44, N34, N44, Z12, Z13）

articles.title_en: Fighting for Tyranny: State Repression and Combat Motivation
articles.title_cn: 为暴政而战：国家镇压与战斗动机
articles.abstract_en: We utilize over 100 million declassified Red Army personnel records from World War II to study how state repression shapes soldiers’ motivation to exert effort in fighting. Exploiting multiple complementary identification strategies, we find that soldiers from places with higher levels of prewar repression under Stalin’s rule were more likely to fight until death and less likely to shirk their duties, but they also received fewer decorations for personal bravery. The coercive incentives created by repression appear to have induced obedience at the expense of initiative and increased the human costs of war. (JEL D74, F51, H56, J45, N34, N44, P26)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用二战期间超过100亿份解密的红军人员档案，研究国家镇压如何塑造士兵在战斗中的努力动机。通过多种互补的识别策略，我们发现，来自斯大林统治下战前镇压水平较高地区的士兵更可能战斗至死，且更少逃避职责，但他们获得的个人英勇勋章也较少。镇压所产生的强制性激励似乎以牺牲主动性为代价诱导了服从，并增加了战争的人力成本。(JEL D74, F51, H56, J45, N34, N44, P26)

articles.title_en: Activated History: The Case of the Turkish Sieges of Vienna
articles.title_cn: 被激活的历史：土耳其围攻维也纳的案例
articles.abstract_en: We show that history stored in collective memories and activated by political campaigns can create xenophobia and radicalization. Turkish troops besieged Vienna in 1529 and 1683 and pillaged individual Austrian villages, killing and kidnapping in the process. Attacked places remember those events well but never expressed aversion to Muslims until far-right populists started to campaign against Turks and Muslims in the mid-2000s. We find anti-Muslim sentiments and far-right voting surge in previously attacked places after the populist campaigns were launched, and Turkish communities decrease in response. Historical narratives in political campaigns can mobilize both beliefs and actions. (JEL D72, D83, J15, N43, Z12, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，存储在集体记忆中并由政治运动激活的历史可以制造仇外心理和激进化。土耳其军队在1529年和1683年围攻维也纳，并掠夺了奥地利的各个村庄，在此过程中杀害和绑架。遭受袭击的地方对这些事件记忆犹新，但直到极右翼民粹主义者于2000年代中期开始针对土耳其人和穆斯林发起运动之前，从未表达过对穆斯林的厌恶。我们发现，在民粹主义运动发起后，先前遭受袭击的地方的反穆斯林情绪和极右翼投票激增，而土耳其社区则相应减少。政治运动中的历史叙事可以动员信念和行动。（JEL D72, D83, J15, N43, Z12, Z13）

articles.title_en: Health Care Centralization: The Health Impacts of Obstetric Unit Closures in the United States
articles.title_cn: 医疗保健集中化：美国产科病房关闭对健康的影响
articles.abstract_en: Over the last few decades, health care services in the United States have become more geographically centralized. We study how the loss of hospital-based obstetric units in over 400 counties affects maternal and infant health via a difference-in-differences design. We find that closures lead mothers to experience a significant change in birth procedures such as inductions and C-sections. In contrast to concerns voiced in the public discourse, the effects on a range of maternal and infant health outcomes are negligible or slightly beneficial. While women travel farther to receive care, closures induce women to receive higher quality care. (JEL I11, I18, J13, J16)
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，美国的医疗保健服务在地理上变得更加集中。我们通过双重差分设计研究了超过400个县中医院产科病房的关闭对母婴健康的影响。我们发现，关闭导致母亲在生产程序（如引产和剖腹产）上经历显著变化。与公共讨论中表达的担忧相反，对一系列母婴健康结果的影响可以忽略不计或略有好处。虽然女性需要旅行更远才能获得护理，但关闭促使女性获得更高质量的护理。（JEL I11, I18, J13, J16）

articles.title_en: The Impacts of Physician Payments on Patient Access, Use, and Health
articles.title_cn: 医生支付对患者就医可及性、使用和健康的影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine how supply-side health insurance generosity affects patient access, use, and health. Exploiting large, exogenous changes in Medicaid reimbursement rates for physicians, we find that increasing payments for new patient office visits reduces reports of providers turning away beneficiaries: closing the gap in payments between Medicaid and private insurers would reduce more than half of disparities in access among adults and would eliminate such disparities among children. We further find that higher physician reimbursement leads to more office visits, better self-reported health, and reduced school absenteeism among the program’s beneficiaries. (JEL G22, H51, I11, I13, I18, I38, J44)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了供给侧健康保险慷慨程度如何影响患者的就医可及性、使用和健康。利用医疗补助计划对医生报销率的大规模外生变化，我们发现增加新患者办公室就诊的支付会减少提供者拒绝受益人的报告：缩小医疗补助与私人保险支付之间的差距将减少成年人就医可及性差异的一半以上，并消除儿童中的此类差异。我们进一步发现，更高的医生报销导致更多的办公室就诊、更好的自报健康以及计划受益人缺勤率的降低。(JEL G22, H51, I11, I13, I18, I38, J44)

articles.title_en: Patient versus Provider Incentives in Long-Term Care
articles.title_cn: 长期护理中的患者与提供者激励
articles.abstract_en: How do patient and provider incentives affect the provision of long-term care? Our analysis of 551,000 nursing home stays yields three main insights. First, due to limited cost-sharing, Medicaid-covered residents prolong their nursing home stays instead of transitioning to community-based care. Second, when facility capacity binds, nursing homes shorten Medicaid stays to admit more profitable out-of-pocket private payers. Third, providers react more elastically to financial incentives than patients. Thus, targeting provider incentives through alternative payment models, such as episode-based reimbursement, is more effective than increasing patient cost sharing in facilitating transitions to community-based care and generating long-term care savings. (JEL H51, H75, I11, I13, I18, I38, L84)
articles.abstract_cn: 患者和提供者的激励如何影响长期护理的提供？我们对551,000例养老院住院的分析得出三个主要见解。首先，由于有限的自付费用分担，医疗补助覆盖的居民延长了他们在养老院的停留时间，而不是转向社区护理。其次，当设施容量受限时，养老院缩短医疗补助居民的停留时间，以接纳更有利可图的自费私人支付者。第三，提供者对财务激励的反应比患者更具弹性。因此，通过替代支付模式（如基于事件的报销）针对提供者激励，比增加患者费用分担在促进向社区护理过渡和产生长期护理节省方面更为有效。（JEL H51, H75, I11, I13, I18, I38, L84）

articles.title_en: Socioeconomic Disparities in Privatized Pollution Remediation: Evidence from Toxic Chemical Spills
articles.title_cn: 私有化污染修复中的社会经济差距：来自有毒化学品泄漏的证据
articles.abstract_en: Governments often privatize the administration of regulations to third-party specialists paid for by the regulated parties. We study how the resulting conflict of interest can have unintended consequences for the distributional impacts of regulation. In Massachusetts, the party responsible for hazardous waste contamination must hire a licensed contractor to quantify the environmental severity. We find that contractors’ evaluations favor their clients, exhibiting substantial score bunching just below thresholds that determine government oversight of the remediation. Client favoritism is more pronounced in socioeconomically disadvantaged neighborhoods and is associated with inferior remediation quality, highlighting a novel channel for inequities in pollution exposure. (JEL D63, J15, K32, L51, Q53, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 政府通常将法规的管理私有化，交由受监管方付费的第三方专家执行。我们研究了由此产生的利益冲突如何对法规的分配效应产生意想不到的后果。在马萨诸塞州，负责危险废物污染的一方必须聘请有执照的承包商来量化环境严重程度。我们发现承包商的评估偏向其客户，在决定政府监督修复的阈值以下表现出大量的分数聚集。客户偏袒在社会经济弱势社区更为明显，并与较差的修复质量相关，突显了污染暴露不平等的一个新渠道。(JEL D63, J15, K32, L51, Q53, R23)

articles.title_en: Civil Service Exams and Organizational Performance: Evidence from the Pendleton Act
articles.title_cn: 文官考试与组织绩效：来自《彭德尔顿法案》的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use newly digitized data to study the impacts of a historical reform that mandated exams for some employees in the largest US customs-collection districts. Although the reform improved targeted employees’ professional backgrounds and reduced turnover, it did not lead to significant improvements in the cost-effectiveness of customs revenue collection. The incomplete reach of the reform was key for this partial success. First, the reform incentivized hiring in exam-exempted positions, distorting districts’ hierarchical structure. Second, since we find suggestive evidence that districts’ top managers mattered for performance, not changing their appointment method might have constituted a missed opportunity for improvement. (JEL D23, D73, H83, J45, N31, N41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用新近数字化的数据，研究了一项历史性改革的影响，该改革要求美国最大的关税征收区中的部分雇员必须通过考试。尽管改革改善了目标雇员的专业背景并降低了人员流动率，但并未显著提高关税征收的成本效益。改革覆盖范围的不完整是这种部分成功的关键。首先，改革激励了在免试职位上的雇佣，扭曲了各区的层级结构。其次，由于我们发现暗示性的证据表明各区的最高管理者对绩效有影响，不改变他们的任命方式可能构成了错失改进机会。（JEL D23, D73, H83, J45, N31, N41）

articles.title_en: When Individual Politics Become Public: Do Civil Service Protections Insulate Government Workers?
articles.title_cn: 当个人政治变为公共事务：公务员保护是否使政府工作人员免受影响？
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether the civil service system protected state bureaucrats from political interference following a recall petition against the governor of Wisconsin. I find that most classified workers, who were covered by the state civil service laws, were paid equally by signing status following the public disclosure of the petition list. Conversely, signers in the unclassified service, a smaller set of government positions, were paid about 3 percent less annually relative to nonsigners in the postdisclosure period. These results indicate that the civil service insulated qualified bureaucrats, while uncovered workers faced retribution. (JEL D72, D73, H75, H83, J31, J45)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在针对威斯康星州州长的罢免请愿之后，公务员制度是否保护了州官僚免受政治干预。我发现，在请愿名单公开披露后，大多数受州公务员法律保护的分类工作人员，其薪酬并未因签署身份而有所不同。相反，在未分类服务中（一个较小的政府职位群体），签署者在披露后时期的年薪比非签署者低约3%。这些结果表明，公务员制度保护了合格的官僚，而未受保护的工作人员则面临报复。（JEL D72, D73, H75, H83, J31, J45）

articles.title_en: Public Information Is an Incentive for Politicians: Experimental Evidence from Delhi Elections
articles.title_cn: 公共信息是对政治家的激励：来自德里选举的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Two years prior to elections, two-thirds of Delhi municipal councillors learned they had been randomly chosen for a preelection newspaper report card. Treated councillors in high-slum areas increased pro-poor spending, relative both to control counterparts and treated counterparts from low-slum areas. Treated incumbents ineligible to rerun in home wards because of randomly assigned gender quotas were substantially likelier to run elsewhere only if their report card showed a strong pro-poor spending record. Parties also benefited electorally from councillors’ high pro-poor spending. In contrast, in a cross-cut experiment, councillors did not react to actionable information that was not publicly disclosed. (JEL D72, D83, H75, J16, O15, O17, O18)
articles.abstract_cn: 在选举前两年，德里市议员中有三分之二得知他们被随机选中参加选举前的报纸报告卡。在贫民窟比例高的地区，被处理的议员增加了有利于穷人的支出，相对于对照组和来自低贫民窟地区的被处理议员。由于随机分配的性别配额而无资格在所在选区连任的被处理现任议员，只有在他们的报告卡显示出强大的有利于穷人支出记录时，才更有可能在其他地方竞选。政党也从议员的高有利于穷人支出中获得了选举利益。相比之下，在一个交叉实验中，议员对未公开披露的可操作信息没有反应。(JEL D72, D83, H75, J16, O15, O17, O18)

articles.title_en: The Great Migration and Educational Opportunity
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of the First Great Migration on children. We use the complete-count 1940 census to estimate selection-corrected place effects on education for children of Black migrants. On average, Black children gained 0.8 years of schooling (12 percent) by moving from the South to the North. Many counties that had the strongest positive impacts on children during the 1940s offer relatively poor opportunities for Black youth today. Opportunities for Black children were greater in places with more schooling investment, stronger labor market opportunities for Black adults, more social capital, and less crime. (JEL H75, I26, J13, J15, J24, N32, N92)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了第一次大迁徙对儿童的影响。我们使用完整的1940年人口普查数据，估计了黑人移民子女教育的选择校正地点效应。平均而言，黑人儿童从南方迁移到北方获得了0.8年的教育（12%）。在1940年对儿童产生最强积极影响的许多县，如今为黑人青年提供的机会相对较差。黑人儿童的机会在学校投资更多、黑人成人劳动力市场机会更强、社会资本更多、犯罪更少的地方更大。（JEL H75, I26, J13, J15, J24, N32, N92）

articles.title_en: The Evolution of Local Labor Markets after Recessions
articles.title_cn: 衰退后地方劳动力市场的演变
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how US local labor markets respond to employment losses that occur during recessions. Following recessions from 1973 through 2009, we find areas that lose more jobs during the recession experience persistent relative declines in employment and population. Most importantly, these local labor markets also experience persistent decreases in the employment-population ratio, earnings per capita, and earnings per worker. Our results imply that limited population responses result in longer-lasting consequences for local labor markets than previously thought and that recessions are followed by persistent reallocation of employment across space. (JEL E32, J21, J31, J61, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了美国地方劳动力市场如何应对衰退期间发生的就业损失。在1973年至2009年的衰退之后，我们发现，在衰退期间失去更多就业机会的地区，其就业和人口会经历持续的相对下降。最重要的是，这些地方劳动力市场的就业人口比率、人均收入和每个工人的收入也持续下降。我们的结果表明，有限的人口反应导致地方劳动力市场的后果比之前认为的更为持久，并且衰退之后伴随着就业在空间上的持续重新配置。（JEL E32, J21, J31, J61, R23）

articles.title_en: The Impact of Benefit Generosity on Workers’ Compensation Claims: Evidence and Implications
articles.title_cn: 福利慷慨程度对工伤赔偿索赔的影响：证据与启示
articles.abstract_en: Leveraging unique administrative data and a sharp increase in benefit generosity in a difference-in-differences research design, we estimate the impact of workers’ compensation wage replacement benefits on individual behavior and program costs. We find that increased benefit generosity leads to longer income benefit durations and increased medical spending. Responses along these two margins are equally important drivers of increased program costs, collectively increasing program costs 1.4 times the mechanical increase in costs. Using these estimates and an estimate of the consumption drop among injured workers, our welfare calibrations suggest that a marginal increase in benefit generosity would not improve welfare. (JEL D91, I11, J28, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用独特的行政数据和双重差分研究设计中福利慷慨程度的急剧增加，我们估计了工伤赔偿工资替代福利对个人行为和项目成本的影响。我们发现，福利慷慨程度的提高导致收入福利持续时间延长和医疗支出增加。这两个方面的反应对项目成本增加的贡献同等重要，共同使项目成本增加了机械性成本增加的1.4倍。利用这些估计和受伤工人消费下降的估计，我们的福利校准表明，福利慷慨程度的边际增加不会改善福利。（JEL D91, I11, J28, J31）

articles.title_en: Spillovers without Social Interactions in Urban Sanitation
articles.title_cn: 城市卫生设施中的无社会互动溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: We run a randomized controlled trial coupled with lab-in-the-field social network experiments in urban Dakar. Decision spillovers and health externalities play a large role in determining uptake of sanitation technology, with decision spillovers being largest among households that don’t receive significant subsidies. There is no evidence that the spillovers are explained by social forces in general, nor by specific social mechanisms such as learning from others, social pressure, or reciprocity. We do find evidence of a fourth, nonsocial, mechanism impacting decisions: increasing health benefits. As more neighbors adopt the sanitary technology, it becomes more worthwhile for other households to adopt as well. (JEL I12, O12, O13, O18, Q53, Q55, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在达喀尔城市地区开展了一项随机对照试验，并结合实地实验室社会网络实验。决策溢出和健康外部性在决定卫生技术采用方面发挥着重要作用，其中决策溢出在未获得大量补贴的家庭中最为显著。没有证据表明这些溢出效应总体上由社会力量解释，也没有证据表明其由特定社会机制（如向他人学习、社会压力或互惠）解释。我们确实发现了第四种非社会机制影响决策的证据：健康收益的增加。随着更多邻居采用卫生技术，其他家庭采用该技术也变得更有价值。(JEL I12, O12, O13, O18, Q53, Q55, Z13)

articles.title_en: The Human Capital Effects of Access to Elite Jobs
articles.title_cn: 精英就业机会的人力资本效应
articles.abstract_en: We study the human capital effects of access to elite bureaucratic jobs in Taiwan, where performance on an examination determines entry into the civil service. Historically, quotas for successful applicants were set based on the 1948 populations of individuals’ native provinces in mainland China. This resulted in a higher probability of success on the exam—and, thus, greater access to elite positions—for descendants of certain migrant groups. These preferential quotas were replaced in 1962 with a uniform admissions policy. Using this variation, we find that the incentives created by preferential quotas increased human capital and improved long-run economic outcomes. (JEL D73, H83, J24, J45, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了台湾地区精英官僚职位获取机会的人力资本效应，在那里，考试成绩决定是否进入公务员队伍。历史上，成功申请者的配额是根据1948年个人原籍省份在大陆的人口设定的。这导致某些移民群体的后代在考试中成功的概率更高，从而更容易获得精英职位。这些优惠配额在1962年被统一的招生政策所取代。利用这一变化，我们发现优惠配额产生的激励增加了人力资本并改善了长期经济成果。(JEL D73, H83, J24, J45, M51)

articles.title_en: Consumer Protection in an Online World: An Analysis of Occupational Licensing
articles.title_cn: 在线世界中的消费者保护：职业许可分析
articles.abstract_en: We study the demand and supply implications of occupational licensing using transaction-level data from a large online platform for home improvement services. We find that demand is more responsive to a professional’s reviews than to the professional’s platform-verified licensing status. We show some evidence that consumers view licenses and reviews as substitutes. We confirm the generality of our findings off the platform in an independent consumer survey. Combining state-level licensing regulation data with platform microdata, we find that more stringent requirements are associated with less competition, higher prices, and no increase in demand or consumer satisfaction. (JEL D18, J44, L74, L84)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个大型在线家居装修服务平台的交易级数据，研究职业许可的需求和供给影响。我们发现，需求对专业人士的评价比对其平台验证的许可状态更为敏感。我们展示了一些证据，表明消费者将许可和评价视为替代品。我们在平台外的独立消费者调查中证实了研究结果的普遍性。将州级许可监管数据与平台微观数据相结合，我们发现更严格的要求与更少的竞争、更高的价格以及需求或消费者满意度没有增加相关。(JEL D18, J44, L74, L84)
